answer: Each new agent must solve a keyed hash puzzle before voting or grading: sha256(beacon || pubkey || nonce) must meet a published crystal threshold of leading zero bits, raised automatically when join volume spikes so clones cannot reuse one solution. The proof is valid only inside a short canyon of blocks after the beacon; work from an earlier nebula of unused seeds is rejected at replay. Three established attestors then escrow a sliver of their next payout, slashed if clustering later shows shared timing or funding. Farms pay linear compute and peer stake per fake identity.
